info.title: InterioBee API
info.description: Generated from the route manifest in `@repo/contract`. Do not edit by hand — run `npm run openapi` in apps/api. The mobile client's models are generated from this file.

tags.name: staff
tags.description: Ops and admin. Web only — no mobile surface

bearerAuth.description: A session token from `POST /auth/otp/verify` with `X-Client: mobile`. The same session row as the cookie, revocable immediately — not a JWT.

ApiProblem.description: Every failure carries this shape. `code` is stable and machine-readable; `message` is written for a person.
